### The Truth Behind Atheism
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-january-7-2014.html
Passage: Psalm 14:1
Points:
- Scripture does not debate God's existence but identifies atheistic thinking as fundamentally mistaken.
- Attributing the origin and complexity of life to blind chance is irrational.
- Rejection of God stems primarily from a rebellious heart seeking to avoid moral accountability.
- The existence of creation logically requires a transcendent Creator.
- Believers come to know the Creator personally through faith in Jesus Christ.

### God's Self-Existence
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-self-existence
Passage: Psalm 14:1
Points:
- Denying God overlooks the fundamental requirement for why anything exists at all.
- Divine aseity teaches that God is completely self-sufficient and independent of external causes.
- Claims of self-creation are illogical because an effect cannot produce itself.
- The universe logically demands an eternal, uncaused first cause.
- Because humans possess personality, the ultimate Creator must be personal rather than an impersonal force.
